newsitem.title: USA: Man found guilty in triple slaying in Ohio.
newsitem.headline: Man found guilty in triple slaying in Ohio.

text.p: A truck driver was found guilty Wednesday of killing three co-workers in a shooting rampage touched off by a dispute with one of them.

Gerald Clemmons, 54, could be sentenced to death following his conviction on three counts of aggravated murder following a jury trial in Hamilton County Common Pleas Court. Sentencing was set for Oct. 22.
"I feel like a monster," Clemmons had told the court Tuesday, "like somebody that has no conscience, no self- control."
He had testified that the shootings last Dec. 15 at a trucking firm in Evandale, Ohio, near Cincinnati, occurred because of a dispute he had with a dispatcher.
Police said he went to work with two guns and shot the three at the office of the trucking company.
